summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Global Payment Gateway screens (Iteration 12). Backend: 8/8 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All payment gateway features working correctly including 4 payment method buttons, card form with brand detection, Luhn validation, expiry validation, saved cards section for logged-in users, and OrderSuccessPage states.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment methods API correctly returns empty list for guests (no 401 error)
POST /api/payment-methods requires authentication - returns 401 for guests
Duplicate payment method (same brand+last4) returns existing doc, not duplicate insert
last4 field correctly truncates to last 4 digits (e.g., '1234567' → '4567')
Auto-save card on paid order logic verified in code (server.py:1049-1075)
Frontend shows 4 payment method buttons with logos (Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal)
Card is default selected with card form visible for guests
Brand detection works: Visa (4242), Amex (3782), Discover (6011)
Luhn validation shows 'Invalid card number' for invalid numbers
Expiry validation shows 'Card is expired' for past dates
Non-card methods show info panel with redirect message
Pay button disabled until terms checked + valid card form
Logged-in users see 'Saved cards' section with 'Add new card' toggle
OrderSuccessPage shows loading state while polling, error state for invalid sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 Global Payment Gateway fully tested. Key features verified: (1) Backend payment-methods API: GET returns empty for guests, POST requires auth, CRUD operations work, duplicate detection, last4 truncation, validation. (2) Frontend Payment Step: 4 method buttons (Card/Apple Pay/Google Pay/PayPal) with logos, Card default selected, card form with brand detection (Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover), Luhn validation, expiry validation, CVV by brand, cardholder name. (3) Non-card methods show info panel with Stripe redirect message. (4) Pay button disabled until terms + valid card. (5) Logged-in users see Saved Cards section with 'Add new card' toggle. (6) OrderSuccessPage: loading state while polling, error state for invalid sessions with 'Try again' button. (7) CSS animation @keyframes scale-in defined for success checkmark. MOCKED: Saved cards are mocked (brand+last4 stored per user, never real card data). PayPal/Apple Pay/Google Pay are visual-only, all route through Stripe Checkout.
